meta.description: Aircraft Metals Technology shop performs precision manufacturing, fabrication, repair, and inspection of critical aircraft structures, components, and support equipment. Daily shop operations center on high‑accuracy machining and welding processes that restore serviceability and ensure mission‑ready assets.
meta.medicalFacility:
If you become ill after hours with an urgent condition—one that requires treatment within 24 hours—you must use the Emergent Care Center (ECC) at Malcolm Grow Medical Facility or another local military emergency department.

The Emergency Care Center at Joint Base Andrews is open from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., seven days a week. Patients requiring emergency medical care after hours will be directed, or transported by ambulance if calling 911, to a nearby civilian hospital emergency department.
meta.evacuationRoute:
If an emergency requires immediate evacuation:

Machining Operations:  
Securely shut down the machine and ensure all motion has stopped.

CNC Programs:  
Pause the program and allow the machine to come to a complete stop.

Welding Operations:  
Turn off the welder and close all valves on gas cylinders.

Evacuate the hangar immediately and proceed to the designated assembly area.
Once outside the building, move toward the designated assembly area located in the parking lot northeast of the hangar.
